content.sentence: The technician __________ the server rack without grounding it, and a sudden spark damaged the power module.
Yesterday, the trainees __________ the cooling fans, so the network switch overheated and shut down.
__________ the administrator __________ the emergency shutdown command when the database started corrupting files?
The support team __________ the faulty cable properly, so half the office lost connectivity.
The software engineer __________ the firewall rules correctly, and the system avoided a major intrusion.
The supervisor __________ the UPS immediately after getting a burning smell near the backup batteries.
__________ the interns __________ all external drives before the malware spread across the network?
The IT team __________ the heating CPU in time, so the workstation crashed completely.
The network technician __________ the loose fibre connector and prevented a full system outage.
The admin __________ the security settings wrongly, and several user accounts locked instantly.
__________ the supervisor __________ the data backup before restarting the whole server cluster?
The maintenance team __________ the faulty fan inside the router properly, so the device overheated during peak usage.

activity_b.text: The technician touched the server rack without grounding it, and a sudden spark damaged the power module.
Yesterday, the trainees didn’t clean the cooling fans, so the network switch overheated and shut down.
Did the administrator run the emergency shutdown command when the database started corrupting files?
The support team didn’t replace the faulty cable properly, so half the office lost connectivity.
The software engineer configured the firewall rules correctly, and the system avoided a major intrusion.
The supervisor switched off the UPS immediately after getting a burning smell near the backup batteries.
Did the interns disconnect all external drives before the malware spread across the network?
The IT team didn’t cool the heating CPU in time, so the workstation crashed completely.
The network technician noticed the loose fibre connector and prevented a full system outage.
The admin updated the security settings wrongly, and several user accounts locked instantly.
Did the supervisor check the data backup before restarting the whole server cluster?
The maintenance team didn’t replace the faulty fan inside the router properly, so the device overheated during peak usage.

activity_c.text: Today, I want to talk to you about handling some of the more serious emergencies that can occur on the workshop floor.
These situations are not meant to scare you, but to help you stay safe and confident while you work.
Always take a moment to check the pressure gauge before you begin.
Last month, one group didn’t follow the checklist properly, and the steamer released hot steam all of a sudden.
This morning, we noticed a possible gas leak, so the maintenance team is working on it right now.
If this ever happens while you’re around, don’t switch on any electrical device and step away from the area.
Last week, someone accidentally mixed two powerful sanitisers, and the fumes irritated people’s eyes.
We also need to pay attention to electrical safety.
Yesterday, a damaged cable was left near the chiller, and the student who noticed it didn’t report it.
A quick report can prevent a big problem.
